title: Launch Conductor: cross-team timeline template and runbook for staggered runtime/console/api trains
creator: Lina Chen
description: Create a reusable 'Launch Conductor' template and an associated cross-team timeline for coordinating staggered release trains across the runtime, console, and API surfaces. This ticket captures the canonical timeline matrix, a daily/weekly runbook, gating criteria, escalation paths, and a lightweight tooling checklist (Slack + dashboards + release flags) so that product, eng, and design can execute simultaneous but phased rollouts with predictable rollback mechanics.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable timeline template (CSV + Confluence page) that can be copied for future launches
A runbook with owner-assigned daily/weekly check-ins for all three trains (runtime/console/api)
Gating criteria defined and automated where possible (health checks, SLOs, error budget thresholds, end-to-end smoke tests)
Escalation matrix and on-call responsibilities documented and validated with a tabletop exercise
A rollout calendar published to the org and linked from relevant OKR/initiative docs
milestones: 2026-03-05: Draft timeline and initial stakeholder alignment meeting
2026-03-10: Runbook first-pass and action owners assigned
2026-03-18: Technical gating checks spec complete (ENG + SRE)
2026-04-01: Finalized template, published and handed off to Release Ops
timeline_matrix: Matrix rows: feature buckets / train (runtime|console|api) / owner / planned rollout window / canary window / rollback window / monitoring dashboards / verification tests. Columns include: pre-freeze signoffs, cutover window, canary % progression, fallback model mapping (e.g., runtime-quantized->full-precision), and deprecation note for previous endpoints.
rollout_policy: Staggered progression with dependency awareness: console changes only promoted after runtime canary reaches 80% success on E2E smoke tests; API clients get header-based opt-in for 48h post-canary; automatic rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% above baseline for 15 minutes or token-latency P95 > 2x SLO for 10 minutes. Manual override allowed by Release Owner + SRE lead.
coordination_checklist: Book weekly 30m launch sync (Product, Eng, Design, SRE, Release Ops)
Populate timeline template and attach to PRD and OKR initiative
Assign verification owners for each train and tests (smoke, integration, load)
Create temporary feature flags and canary groups in infrastructure
Wire up dashboards: per-model latency, error budgets, cost burn rate, token throughput
Prepare rollback plan and document fallback model variants
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Runtime performance regression discovered during canary. Mitigation: pre-canary perf harness and rollback to previous kernel set; circuit-breaker for high-latency routes.
Risk: Console schema change breaks integrations. Mitigation: API contract tests + opt-in header and parallel run mode for 72h.
Risk: Cross-team misalignment on release dates. Mitigation: single source-of-truth timeline and weekly sync; Release Owner has final signoff authority.
Risk: Insufficient telemetry granularity. Mitigation: short-term telemetry agents added to canary cohort and elevated logging for 48h
